name: Pixel
summary: At Splintertree Post, Pixel carries Warsong goods through dangerous Ashenvale for a fee. She keeps the saw blades until paid and seeks other cargo worth carrying.

sections.title: Business in the Deep Woods
sections.body:
From Splintertree Post, where the Horde holds a fortified post in Ashenvale, Pixel carries freight for the Warsong Clan. She takes goods through active war zones to support the clan’s logging work, guided by coin and contracts.

The saw blades stay with her until she is paid. For this shipment, she wants a deadly blunderbuss to guard herself on the road. She also pays travelers for satyr horns, much sought after in Ratchet.

faq.answer: Pixel is a goblin courier working from Splintertree Post in eastern Ashenvale. She carries cargo through dangerous lands, including saw blades for the Warsong logging effort.

faq.q: Why won't Pixel hand over the saw blades immediately?
faq.answer: Pixel keeps the saw blades until she receives payment or trade goods to cover her fee. Even with the Horde’s urgent needs in Ashenvale, she holds to her business terms.

faq.q: Why does she want satyr horns?
faq.answer: Pixel wants satyr horns because they are in high demand in Ratchet, where she is headed next. She cannot take on the satyrs of Night Run, Satyrnaar and Xavian herself, so she pays travelers to gather horns for her to sell.

faq.q: Is Pixel officially a member of the Horde?
faq.answer: Pixel works with the Horde at Splintertree Post through profitable contracts for the Warsong logging operations. Her chief loyalty is to trade, profit and fulfilling her delivery agreements.

angles.text: As a Horde champion helping establish a foothold in Ashenvale, you can rely on Pixel to supply the industrial hardware the Warsong Clan needs to keep its logging machinery running.
